tools.name: search_steps
tools.description: Searches the catalog of WordPress Playground steps and returns their descriptions and configurable fields. Use when discovering which steps to add to a blueprint or checking the variable names a step accepts.

query.description: Keywords matching a step name, description, or variable

include_builtin.description: Whether to include native built-in WordPress Playground steps (defaults to true)

page_size.description: Number of steps per page (up to 12)

tools.name: list_examples
tools.description: Lists starter blueprint templates with their titles, slugs, and step counts. Use when the user wants inspiration or a pre-built starting blueprint to load.

query.description: Optional keyword to filter example titles or slugs

page_size.description: Number of examples per page (up to 12)

tools.name: get_blueprint_state
tools.description: Reads the active blueprint workspace including its title, ordered steps with indices and values, active settings, and manual-edit status. Use before editing, reordering, or removing existing steps.

page.description: Page number for the steps list starting at 1

page_size.description: Number of steps per page (up to 12)

tools.name: update_blueprint_steps
tools.description: Adds, updates, removes, or reorders one or more steps in the active blueprint workspace and recompiles it. Use when building or modifying a blueprint's step sequence in a single batch.

operations.description: Ordered list of step changes to apply

action.description: Change to perform on a step

step.description: Step name from search_steps (required for add)

index.description: Zero-based position of an existing step (for update, remove, move, or insert position)

vars.description: Step variable values keyed by variable name

count.description: Repeat count for steps that support multiple executions

force.description: Set true only after user confirmation to exit manual JSON edit mode

tools.name: update_blueprint_settings
tools.description: Updates runtime and compilation settings for the active blueprint and recompiles it. Use when changing WordPress or PHP versions, blueprint title, v1 or v2 format, display mode, storage, or WP-CLI preloading.

networking.description: Enable outbound networking for plugin and theme installs

encoding_format.description: How the blueprint is encoded into Playground URLs

site_slug.description: Lowercase alphanumeric slug with hyphens for saving the site in Playground

exclude_meta.description: Omit metadata headers from the compiled blueprint

force.description: Set true only after user confirmation to exit manual JSON edit mode

tools.name: load_example_blueprint
tools.description: Loads a pre-built example blueprint into the active workspace and recompiles it. Use when the user picks a starter template from the examples list.

example.description: Example slug or exact title from list_examples

force.description: Set true only after user confirmation to replace existing workspace steps

tools.name: clear_blueprint
tools.description: Removes all steps and clears the title from the active blueprint workspace. Use only when the user explicitly asks to wipe or start over from an empty blueprint.

tools.name: set_preview_mode
tools.description: Toggles or repositions the embedded WordPress Playground live preview pane. Use when the user asks to show, move, or hide the live preview.

position.description: Where to place the live preview pane

tools.name: get_blueprint_output
tools.description: Retrieves the compiled WordPress Playground blueprint JSON, shareable launch and redirect URLs, or a branch-testing AI instructions snippet. Use when the user wants to inspect, copy, or share the compiled result.

url_type.description: Link style when generating AI instructions (defaults to step-library)

offset.description: Character offset for reading long JSON or snippet output

limit.description: Maximum characters to return per chunk (up to 1200)

tools.name: list_saved_blueprints
tools.description: Searches and lists blueprints saved in My Blueprints, optionally including saved personal steps. Use when looking up previously saved work to restore, rename, or delete.

query.description: Optional keyword matching saved blueprint titles

page_size.description: Number of saved blueprints per page (up to 12)

tools.name: save_blueprint
tools.description: Saves the active blueprint into My Blueprints or renames an existing saved blueprint. Use when the user wants to bookmark their current setup or change a saved blueprint's title.

title.description: Title to save under (defaults to the current blueprint title or an auto-generated name)

overwrite.description: Set true only after user confirmation to replace an existing entry with the same title

rename_from_id.description: Existing saved blueprint ID to rename instead of creating a new entry

tools.name: restore_saved_blueprint
tools.description: Loads a saved blueprint from My Blueprints back into the active workspace. Use when the user wants to resume working on a previously saved blueprint.

title.description: Saved blueprint title when ID is not yet known

force.description: Set true only after user confirmation to discard unsaved steps in the workspace

tools.name: delete_saved_blueprints
tools.description: Permanently deletes one or more saved blueprints from My Blueprints. Use only after identifying the target saved blueprint IDs and receiving explicit user confirmation.

ids.description: One or more saved blueprint IDs from list_saved_blueprints to delete
